page.title: Dictation Studio
page.purpose: Capture a long-form voice turn, expose streamed and committed text, retain recoverable audio, and make incomplete coverage or terminal failure explicit.

priorities.statement: Make the current capture state and microphone readiness understandable before the operator speaks.
Keep interim and committed transcript text visible without presenting an unacknowledged turn as complete.
Expose captured, sent, processed, durability, and terminal-outcome diagnostics for recovery decisions.
Preserve a clear retry or recovery path when provider, transport, or acknowledgement coverage fails.

states.description: Microphone and speech stream are being acquired; capture has not yet started.
PCM capture is active and the operator may stop the turn.
Capture has stopped and the terminal result or bounded recovery is pending.
A bounded replay copy and terminal result are available to the product.
The turn did not complete successfully; the reason and retained-audio state remain inspectable.
